name: Elysium Flora
description: Thin logs (6 px, six-way connected) for the vanilla woods, craftable 1:1 from logs, and the trunk placer and tree decorators for thin-trunk trees (mesquite, aspen, alder, branch stubs). Leaf tones: every leaf block gets a tone (sun, shade, pale) that shades its tint, placed by the leaf_tones tree decorator. Needed on both sides: it adds blocks.
